note: The curated source store. Each item records what it is, where it is published, its licence and what Agere keeps from it. Agere keeps short summaries in its own words and public code lists, never the text of a copyrighted paper. 2026-11-17: with the owner's approval each source was fetched and the concepts citing it checked against its text; 'verified_against_source' is true (checked), 'partial' (some claims checked, see verification.notes) or false (the text could not be read; summary still unconfirmed), and 'verification' records what was read.
